items.summary: Onion arrivals at the Lasalgaon market rose this week and the modal price eased. Traders expect prices to stay steady until the new crop arrives.
items.title: Onion prices ease at Lasalgaon as arrivals rise

items.summary: Heavy rain cut tomato arrivals at the Pune wholesale market and prices climbed. Traders say supply should recover within a week.
items.title: Tomato prices climb in Pune wholesale market after heavy rain
Government buffer sales keep potato prices steady across India

items.summary: Chilli growers in Kurnool are getting better rates than last season. Demand from traders in other states has increased.
items.title: Kurnool chilli growers see better rates this season

items.summary: Wheat prices in the mandis stayed firm this week. Farmers are holding stocks before the sowing season.
items.title: Mandi prices of wheat stay firm ahead of sowing
